issues.on_page: Transfers 64,325 (Total Primary Government budget schedule, revenues)
issues.issue: 64,325 is the transfers line for the whole primary government, so it includes the Sewer Fund's 'Transfers from other funds' 43,834 (p4), which is already in business_type.transfers_net. The sewer transfer cannot sit in Federal or Other Local Receipts instead: 1,980,987 + 584,932 - 2,557,647 leaves only 8,272, which would go negative. So 43,834 is counted twice across fund types. Governmental transfers in are at most 20,491 (64,325 - 43,834).

issues.extracted: General Government 121,912 + Public Works 85,738 + Public Health 13 + Culture 12,875 = 220,538 recorded as spending, plus transfers_out 43,834 (computed)
issues.on_page: Disbursements and Transfers schedule: no transfers-out line; Total Disbursements and Transfers 2,798,074 ties to ending cash 451,207
issues.issue: The schedule ties to actual cash and counts 64,325 of transfers in, so the matching 64,325 of transfers out has to sit inside its disbursement lines. It is not in the Sewer line: 2,577,536 is below the sewer's cash outflows of 2,578,536, which include no transfers out (p4). So the governmental function lines (220,538) almost certainly contain about 64,325 of transfers out, and the page doesn't say which line. Treating 220,538 as spending and also subtracting transfers_out 43,834 counts transfers as spending. Fix per the hidden-transfer rule: a contra line plus transfers_out 64,325 and transfers_in about 20,491. This leaves the net (-43,834) and the roll-forward unchanged.

issues.on_page: Sewer 2,577,536 (budget schedule p6) vs cash outflows 9,715 + 13,647 + 1,926,038 + 579,804 + 49,332 = 2,578,536 (cash flows p4)
issues.issue: I checked the 1,000 gap. No digit was misread. Each printed statement adds up on its own: budget revenues 2,728,704, resources 3,249,281, disbursements 2,798,074, ending 451,207 = 446,775 + 4,432; sewer cash 164,854 + 22,945 = 187,799; net position 477,233 -> 1,853,449. No line is missing from the trimmed pages. The gap comes from the report's own schedules disagreeing by 1,000 on the Sewer fund, so it belongs in report_discrepancies, where it is. Because governmental receipts are derived by subtraction, the 1,000 may really belong in the residual line receipts[8] (8,272 vs 9,272) or in a governmental spending line. A person should settle this from the full report.
